title: WebhookDeadLetterPage
description: RFC 0188 §A.1 — one page of dead-lettered deliveries for a subscription. This is the read that makes `webhooks.md` §Durability observable: before it, the corpus asserted that an exhausted delivery is routed to a sink `inspectable for retentionDays` and served no endpoint that could see it, so every host's bundle recorded `exhaustion was observed, routing to the sink was not`. The record NAMES a delivery; it never carries the delivered bytes.

deliveries.description: Dead-lettered deliveries, newest first. Empty when the subscription has none within `retentionDays`.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor; absent on the last page. A cursor minted by one subscription MUST NOT be accepted on another (RFC 0182 §A.3 cursor discipline).

deadLetteredDelivery.description: One delivery that will not be retried again. **Content-free by construction (RFC 0188 §B.1):** no request body, no delivery headers, no subscription secret. A dead-letter read is a diagnostic surface, not a payload-replay surface, and a record that carried the body would hand an attacker with read scope every event the subscriber ever failed to receive.

deliveryId.description: The delivery attempt's tenant-bound id. This is the seat that makes the `deliveryId` KIND witnessable: `identity.md` §5 bound it and, until this read existed, no v2 surface returned one, so `v2-bound-id-kinds` recorded a CORPUS gap rather than a host one.

webhookId.description: The subscription the delivery was for. Equals the path segment.

runId.description: The run whose event was being delivered.

eventId.description: The event that was being delivered.

eventType.description: The event type, in the spelling the subscription's contract major renders (RFC 0187 §B).

attempts.description: How many delivery attempts were made before the host gave up. `1` for `payload_unprojectable`, which is dead-lettered on first attempt.

deadLetteredAt.description: When the host routed the delivery to the sink.

expiresAt.description: When this record ages out. **This is what makes `retentionDays` observable rather than merely advertised:** a reader can check `expiresAt − deadLetteredAt` against the advertised facet, which no surface could do before.

reason.description: Why it will not be retried. `retries_exhausted`: the retry policy ran out. `payload_unprojectable`: the event could not be rendered into the subscription's contract major, which `webhooks.md` dead-letters on the FIRST attempt because retrying cannot change the outcome.

lastStatus.description: The HTTP status of the final attempt, when there was a response. Absent when every attempt failed to connect.
